<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#fffaf3">
<title>Harsh &amp; Simran — Wedding Invitation</title>
<style>
@font-face{font-family:'Playfair Display';font-weight:600;font-style:italic;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Lora';font-weight:500;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Lora';font-weight:500;font-style:italic;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Lora';font-weight:600;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Cinzel';font-weight:600;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Cinzel';font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Poppins';font-weight:500;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Poppins';font-weight:600;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Great Vibes';font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond';font-weight:600;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond';font-weight:600;font-style:italic;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Cinzel Decorative';font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
:root{--ivory:#fffaf3;--photo:url("data:image/jpeg;base64,");--paper:#fffdf9;--gold:#c9962f;--gold2:#f0c96a;--wine:#6b1230;--red:#b3121c;--ink:#3a2330;--night:#0b1a4a;
--serif:'Lora',Georgia,serif;--script:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;--caps:'Cinzel',Georgia,serif;--gt:#80560c}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;font-size:calc(16px*var(--bs,1))}
body{font-weight:500;background:linear-gradient(#f7e8dc,#fff4ea);font-family:var(--serif);color:var(--ink);-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
body.lock{overflow:hidden;height:100dvh}
.reel{max-width:480px;margin:0 auto;background:linear-gradient(#fffaf3,#fdeee6 45%,#fffaf3 75%,#fdeee6);box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(201,150,47,.2);position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:100dvh}
section{padding:3.5rem 1.4rem;text-align:center;position:relative}
.script{font-family:var(--script);font-style:var(--si,italic);font-weight:400;color:var(--wine)}
.caps{font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.16em;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--gt)}
h2.script{font-size:calc(2.15rem*var(--ss,1));line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:1.2rem}
p{font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.75}
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity 1s ease,transform 1s ease}
.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* ---------- GATE ---------- */
.gate{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;border:0;cursor:pointer;background:var(--ivory);overflow:hidden;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;color:var(--wine);transition:opacity 1s,visibility 1s}
.gate::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--photo) 40% 35%/cover;filter:blur(9px);transform:scale(1.1);transition:filter 2.4s ease,transform 2.4s ease}
.gate::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(75% 55% at 50% 50%,rgba(255,250,243,.94),rgba(255,250,243,.72) 70%,rgba(255,238,228,.5));transition:opacity 1.8s}
.gate .in{position:relative;z-index:2;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;padding:0 1.5rem;transition:opacity 1s,transform 1.4s}
.gate .inv{font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.35em;font-size:0.82rem;color:var(--gt)}
.ring{position:relative;width:136px;height:136px;display:grid;place-items:center;margin:.4rem 0}
.ring svg{position:absolute;inset:0;transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.ring .a{fill:rgba(255,255,255,.6);stroke:var(--gold);stroke-width:1.6;stroke-dasharray:352;stroke-dashoffset:352;animation:draw 2.6s .3s ease forwards}
.ring .b{fill:none;stroke:var(--gold);stroke-width:.8;stroke-dasharray:2 5;opacity:.7;transform-origin:center;animation:spin 40s linear infinite}
.ring #seal{font-family:var(--script);font-style:var(--si,italic);font-size:calc(1.75rem*var(--ss,1));color:var(--wine);position:relative;white-space:nowrap;line-height:1;letter-spacing:0}
.gate .nm{text-shadow:0 1px 0 #fff;font-family:var(--script);font-style:var(--si,italic);font-size:clamp(calc(2.1rem*var(--ss,1)),calc(10.5vw*var(--ss,1)),calc(2.8rem*var(--ss,1)));line-height:1.1}
.gate .gd{font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.25em;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--ink)}
.pill{margin-top:1.3rem;padding:.9rem 2.2rem;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--gold);background:rgba(255,255,255,.75);font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.3em;font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--wine);animation:pulse2 2.4s infinite}
.gate.open::before{filter:blur(0);transform:scale(1)}
.gate.open::after{opacity:0}
.gate.open .in{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-24px) scale(.96)}
.gate.open .petal{opacity:0}
.gate.open{pointer-events:none}
.gate.gone{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}
.petal{position:absolute;top:-30px;z-index:3;width:12px;height:16px;border-radius:70% 0 70% 0;opacity:.85;animation:fall linear infinite;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .8s}
@keyframes fall{to{transform:translate(40px,110dvh) rotate(540deg)}}
@keyframes draw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes pulse2{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(201,150,47,.45)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 14px rgba(201,150,47,0)}}

/* ---------- HERO ---------- */
.hero{height:100dvh;min-height:560px;padding:0;background:#cfe0f3;overflow:hidden}
.hero .photo{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--photo) 40% 35%/cover;transform:scale(1.15);transition:transform 8s ease-out}
body.opening .hero .photo{transform:scale(1)}
.hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(rgba(20,40,90,.35),transparent 24%,transparent 42%,rgba(255,250,243,.8) 68%,var(--ivory) 90%)}
.hero .top{position:absolute;top:calc(2rem + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));left:0;right:0;z-index:2;font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.3em;font-size:.8rem;color:#fff;font-weight:700;text-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 0 18px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.hero .names{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:5.2rem;z-index:2}
.names .script{color:var(--wine);font-size:clamp(calc(2.3rem*var(--ss,1)),calc(11.5vw*var(--ss,1)),calc(3.1rem*var(--ss,1)));line-height:1.1;display:block}
.names .caps{color:var(--gt);display:block;margin:.2rem 0}
.names .hd{font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--ink);margin-top:.9rem;display:block}
.scroll{position:absolute;bottom:1.4rem;left:0;right:0;z-index:2;font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;font-size:0.80rem;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--gt);animation:bob 2s infinite}
@keyframes bob{50%{transform:translateY(6px)}}

/* ---------- INVITE + SCRATCH ---------- */
.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(201,150,47,.55);box-shadow:0 0 0 6px #fff,0 0 0 7px rgba(201,150,47,.35),0 16px 40px rgba(201,150,47,.18);border-radius:14px;padding:2rem 1.2rem}
.card .script.big{font-size:calc(2.1rem*var(--ss,1));line-height:1.15;display:block}
.card small{display:block;font-size:1rem;color:#5f424a;margin:.3rem 0 .8rem}
.scratch{position:relative;width:min(300px,80vw);aspect-ratio:1/.92;margin:1.5rem auto 0}
.scratch .under,.scratch canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.scratch .under{display:grid;place-content:center;gap:.2rem;background:var(--paper);clip-path:path('M150 276 C-40 140 40 -10 150 70 C260 -10 340 140 150 276Z');
  clip-path:url(#heartClip)}
.scratch .under b{font-family:var(--script);font-style:var(--si,italic);font-weight:400;font-size:calc(1.9rem*var(--ss,1));color:var(--wine);line-height:1.1}
.scratch .under span{font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--gt)}
.scratch canvas{touch-action:none;cursor:grab;transition:opacity 1s}
.hint{font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.25em;font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--gt);margin-top:.8rem}

/* ---------- BRIDE & GROOM ---------- */
.couple{background:radial-gradient(80% 40% at 50% 8%,rgba(249,211,218,.45),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(70% 35% at 50% 95%,rgba(246,220,148,.3),transparent 70%)}
.couple .sub{font-style:var(--bi,italic);color:#5f424a;margin:-.4rem 0 .5rem}
.pair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1.6rem 1.3rem;align-items:start;margin-top:2rem;position:relative}
.pair .p:nth-child(2){margin-top:3.2rem;transition-delay:.25s}
.frame{position:relative;aspect-ratio:3/4.2;border-radius:999px 999px 14px 14px;padding:6px;background:linear-gradient(#f8e1a0,#c9962f 50%,#f0c96a);box-shadow:0 16px 32px rgba(201,150,47,.3)}
.frame::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-9px;border:1px solid rgba(201,150,47,.55);border-radius:999px 999px 20px 20px;pointer-events:none}
.frame .im{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:999px 999px 9px 9px;overflow:hidden;border:3px solid #fff;background:linear-gradient(#fde9ee,#fff3dc);display:grid;place-content:center;gap:.3rem}
.frame .im img{position:absolute;inset:9px;width:calc(100% - 18px);height:calc(100% - 18px);object-fit:cover;object-position:center 20%;border-radius:999px 999px 6px 6px;display:block}
.im .pl{font-family:var(--script);font-style:var(--si,italic);font-size:calc(3.2rem*var(--ss,1));color:var(--wine);line-height:1}
.im .pt{font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;font-size:0.70rem;letter-spacing:.25em;color:var(--gt)}
.p .role{font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.3em;font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--gt);margin-top:1.5rem}
.p h3{font-family:var(--script);font-style:var(--si,italic);font-weight:400;font-size:calc(1.8rem*var(--ss,1));line-height:1.15;color:var(--wine);margin-top:.2rem}
.p small{display:block;font-size:.95rem;color:#5f424a;line-height:1.4;margin-top:.2rem}
.p p{font-size:1rem;line-height:1.55;margin-top:.6rem}
.heart{position:absolute;left:50%;top:34%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--gold);display:grid;place-items:center;z-index:3;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(201,150,47,.35)}
.heart svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:var(--red);animation:beat 1.8s infinite}
@keyframes beat{50%{transform:scale(1.18)}}

/* ---------- TOGETHER ---------- */
.together{background:radial-gradient(70% 35% at 15% 20%,rgba(249,211,218,.5),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(70% 35% at 90% 80%,rgba(246,220,148,.35),transparent 70%)}
.together .sub{font-style:var(--bi,italic);color:#5f424a;margin:-.4rem 0 2rem}
.tframe{position:relative;width:86%;margin:0 auto;aspect-ratio:4/5.2;border-radius:999px 999px 18px 18px;padding:7px;background:linear-gradient(#f8e1a0,#c9962f 50%,#f0c96a);box-shadow:0 20px 44px rgba(201,150,47,.35)}
.tframe::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-11px;border:1px solid rgba(201,150,47,.6);border-radius:999px 999px 24px 24px;pointer-events:none}
.tframe::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-20px;border:1px dashed rgba(201,150,47,.35);border-radius:999px 999px 32px 32px;pointer-events:none}
.tim{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:999px 999px 11px 11px;overflow:hidden;border:3px solid #fff;background:linear-gradient(#fde9ee,#fff3dc);display:grid;place-content:center;gap:.3rem}
.tim img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 25%;display:block}
.tim .pl{font-family:var(--script);font-style:var(--si,italic);font-size:calc(3.6rem*var(--ss,1));color:var(--wine);line-height:1.1}
.tim .pt{font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.25em;color:var(--gt)}
.tcap{margin-top:2.2rem}
.tcap .tn,.gate .nm,.thanks .nm2{word-spacing:.2em}
.tcap .tn{font-family:var(--script);font-style:var(--si,italic);font-size:calc(2.2rem*var(--ss,1));color:var(--wine);line-height:1.15}
.tcap .td{font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.25em;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--gt);margin-top:.5rem}

/* ---------- COUNTDOWN + CAROUSEL ---------- */
.count{display:flex;gap:.6rem;justify-content:center;margin:.5rem 0 2rem}
.count div{width:74px;padding:.8rem 0;background:var(--paper);border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(80,40,30,.12)}
.count b{display:block;font-size:1.8rem;font-weight:400;color:var(--gt)}
.count span{font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;font-size:0.65rem;letter-spacing:.15em;color:#5f424a}
.stage{position:relative;height:420px;margin:0 -1.4rem}
.stage .ph{position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;width:62%;height:100%;margin-left:-31%;border-radius:8px;background:#ddd center/cover;border:6px solid var(--paper);
  box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25);opacity:0;transform:scale(.7);transition:transform 1.5s ease,opacity 1.5s ease,left 1.5s ease;z-index:0}
.stage .ph.c{opacity:1;transform:none;z-index:2}
.stage .ph.p{opacity:.55;transform:scale(.82);left:6%;z-index:1}
.stage .ph.n{opacity:.55;transform:scale(.82);left:94%;z-index:1}

/* ---------- PRE-WEDDING GALLERY ---------- */
.gsec .sub{font-style:var(--bi,italic);color:#5f424a;margin:-.4rem 0 .5rem}
.sw{display:flex;gap:.45rem;justify-content:center;margin:1rem 0 1.8rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sw button{padding:.5rem 1rem;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(201,150,47,.6);background:#fff;color:var(--wine);font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;font-size:0.70rem;letter-spacing:.18em;cursor:pointer}
.sw button.on{background:var(--wine);color:#fff;border-color:var(--wine)}
#gal .it{cursor:zoom-in;overflow:hidden;position:relative;background:#fff}
#gal img{display:block;width:100%}
.g-polaroid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1.5rem .9rem;padding:.4rem}
.g-polaroid .it{padding:8px 8px 34px;box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(80,40,30,.2);rotate:var(--r,0deg)}
.g-polaroid .it:nth-child(even){margin-top:1.6rem}
.g-polaroid .it::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-2px;left:50%;width:46px;height:16px;margin-left:-23px;background:rgba(240,201,106,.7);z-index:2;rotate:-3deg}
.g-polaroid .it img{aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover}
.g-polaroid .it::after{content:attr(data-cap);position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:6px;font-family:var(--script);font-style:var(--si,italic);font-size:calc(1.05rem*var(--ss,1));color:var(--wine)}
.g-masonry{columns:2;column-gap:.7rem}
.g-masonry .it{break-inside:avoid;margin-bottom:.7rem;border-radius:12px;border:3px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(80,40,30,.15)}
.g-filmstrip{display:flex;gap:1.1rem;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;margin:0 -1.4rem;padding:.6rem 1.4rem 1.4rem;scrollbar-width:none}
.g-filmstrip::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.g-filmstrip .it{flex:0 0 68%;scroll-snap-align:center;aspect-ratio:3/4.2;border-radius:999px 999px 14px 14px;border:4px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--gold),0 14px 28px rgba(201,150,47,.3)}
.g-filmstrip .it img{height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.lb{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:70;background:rgba(24,12,16,.93);display:grid;place-items:center}
.lb[hidden]{display:none}
.lb img{max-width:92vw;max-height:84dvh;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.lb button{position:absolute;border:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);color:#fff;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;font-size:1.8rem;cursor:pointer;line-height:1}
.lb .x{top:calc(1rem + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));right:1rem}.lb .pv{left:.6rem;top:50%}.lb .nx{right:.6rem;top:50%}

/* ---------- STORY / EVENTS ---------- */
.story p{margin-bottom:1rem;max-width:34ch;margin-inline:auto}
.ev{margin-bottom:2.8rem}
.ev .script{font-size:calc(2.05rem*var(--ss,1));line-height:1.1}
.ev .when{font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.18em;font-size:.85rem;margin:.9rem 0 .2rem;color:var(--ink)}
.ev .at{font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.15em;font-size:0.82rem;color:#5f424a}
.ev img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px;margin:1.2rem 0;box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.2);border:5px solid var(--paper)}
.ev .v{font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;font-size:1.25rem;color:var(--gt);margin-top:.4rem}
.ev .a{font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;font-size:.85rem;margin:.5rem 0}
.btn{display:inline-block;margin-top:.8rem;padding:.65rem 1.4rem;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(201,150,47,.5);background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px;font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;font-size:0.80rem;letter-spacing:.15em}

/* ---------- BLESSINGS / RSVP ---------- */
.bless .card div{margin:.9rem 0}
.bless .card b{display:block;font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.15em;font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--ink)}
form.card{text-align:left}
form.card p{text-align:center;margin-bottom:1rem}
.opt{display:flex;gap:.8rem;align-items:center;padding:.5rem 0;font-size:1.15rem;cursor:pointer}
.opt input{accent-color:var(--red);width:20px;height:20px}
.in-name{width:100%;margin:1rem 0 .4rem;padding:.8rem 1rem;border:1px solid rgba(201,150,47,.5);border-radius:8px;font:inherit;font-size:1.1rem;background:#fff}
.send{display:block;width:100%;margin-top:1rem;padding:.95rem;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.25em;font-size:.85rem;cursor:pointer;animation:glow 2.4s infinite}
@keyframes glow{50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 12px rgba(179,18,28,0)}0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(179,18,28,.45)}}
.err{color:var(--red);text-align:center;font-size:1rem;min-height:1.2rem;margin-top:.5rem}

/* ---------- THANK YOU ---------- */

/* ---------- THANK YOU ---------- */
.thanks{position:relative;overflow:hidden;color:#fff;text-align:center;padding:5.5rem 1.6rem 7rem;background:linear-gradient(rgba(107,18,48,.84),rgba(62,8,28,.95)),var(--photo) 40% 40%/cover}
.thanks::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-1px;left:0;right:0;height:26px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 12px 0,#fdeee6 0 12px,transparent 13px) 0 0/24px 26px repeat-x}
.thanks .ring{width:104px;height:104px;margin:0 auto .6rem}
.thanks .ring .a{animation:none;stroke-dashoffset:0;fill:rgba(255,255,255,.08);stroke:var(--gold2)}
.thanks .ring .b{stroke:var(--gold2)}
.thanks .ring #seal2{font-family:var(--script);font-style:var(--si,italic);font-size:calc(1.2rem*var(--ss,1));color:var(--gold2);white-space:nowrap;line-height:1}
.thanks h2{font-family:var(--script);font-style:var(--si,italic);font-weight:400;font-size:calc(3.1rem*var(--ss,1));line-height:1.1;color:var(--gold2);text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.thanks .msg{max-width:30ch;margin:.8rem auto 1.4rem;color:#fbe3e8;font-style:var(--bi,italic)}
.thanks .nm2{font-family:var(--script);font-style:var(--si,italic);font-size:calc(1.9rem*var(--ss,1));color:#fff;line-height:1.1}
.thanks .dv{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem;max-width:240px;margin:1.8rem auto}
.thanks .dv::before,.thanks .dv::after{content:"";flex:1;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold2))}
.thanks .dv::after{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold2),transparent)}
.thanks .dv svg{width:14px;height:14px;fill:var(--gold2)}
.thanks .lbl{font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.3em;font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--gold2);margin-bottom:.8rem}
.thanks .cn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;text-align:left;padding:.9rem 1.1rem;margin:.7rem 0;border:1px solid rgba(240,201,106,.5);border-radius:16px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);color:#fff;text-decoration:none}
.thanks .cn b{display:block;font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:.9rem}
.thanks .cn span{display:block;font-size:1.05rem;color:#fbe3e8;margin-top:.15rem}
.thanks .cn i{flex:0 0 40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold2);display:grid;place-items:center}
.thanks .cn svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:var(--wine)}
.thanks .tag{margin-top:2.2rem;font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.28em;font-size:0.82rem;color:var(--gold2)}
.thanks .see{font-style:var(--bi,italic);color:#fbe3e8;margin-top:.5rem}

/* ---------- FONT SWITCHER ---------- */
.fsw{position:fixed;left:max(1rem,calc(50% - 224px));bottom:calc(1.2rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:45;display:none}
body.started .fsw{display:block}
.fsw[hidden]{display:none!important}
.fsw>button{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--gold);background:#fff;color:var(--wine);font:700 1rem Georgia,serif;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.fsw .pn{display:none;position:absolute;bottom:50px;left:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:14px;padding:.4rem;box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.25);min-width:170px}
.fsw.open .pn{display:block}
.fsw .pn button{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:.6rem .8rem;border:0;background:none;border-radius:8px;font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer}
.fsw .pn button.on{background:var(--wine);color:#fff}

/* ---------- MUSIC DISC ---------- */
.disc{position:fixed;right:max(1rem,calc(50% - 224px));bottom:calc(1.2rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:40;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;border:0;cursor:pointer;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--gold2) 0 7px,#fff 8px 10px,#111 11px);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.5);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity 1s}
body.started .disc{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.disc.play{animation:spin 3s linear infinite}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:3px}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition-duration:.01s!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body class="lock">
<svg width="0" height="0" style="position:absolute"><defs><clipPath id="heartClip" clipPathUnits="objectBoundingBox"><path d="M.5 .97 C-.15 .5 .13 -.04 .5 .25 C.87 -.04 1.15 .5 .5 .97Z"/></clipPath></defs></svg>

<button class="gate" id="gate" aria-label="Tap to open the invitation">
  <div class="in">
    <div class="inv">YOU ARE INVITED</div>
    <div class="ring"><svg viewBox="0 0 136 136"><circle class="b" cx="68" cy="68" r="64"/><circle class="a" cx="68" cy="68" r="56"/></svg><span id="seal"></span></div>
    <div class="nm" id="gname"></div>
    <div class="gd" id="gdate"></div>
    <div class="pill">TAP TO OPEN</div>
  </div>
</button>

<main class="reel">

  <section class="hero">
    <div class="photo"></div>
    <div class="top">WE ARE GETTING MARRIED</div>
    <div class="names rv" id="heroNames"><span class="script" id="gn"></span><span class="caps">WEDS</span><span class="script" id="bn"></span><span class="hd" id="hd"></span></div>
    <div class="scroll">SCROLL</div>
  </section>

  <section class="rv">
    <div class="card">
      <span class="script big" style="font-size:calc(1.5rem*var(--ss,1))">We Cordially Invite You</span>
      <p>Together with our beloved families, we request the honour of your gracious presence to celebrate the wedding of</p>
      <span class="script big" id="gn2"></span><small id="gp"></small>
      <p style="margin:0">with</p>
      <span class="script big" id="bn2"></span><small id="bp"></small>
    </div>
    <div style="margin-top:3rem">
      <div class="caps">A SPECIAL SURPRISE</div>
      <p style="font-family:var(--caps);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;font-size:1.1rem;margin:.6rem 0">SCRATCH THE HEART TO REVEAL OUR WEDDING DATE</p>
      <div class="scratch" id="scratch"><div class="under"><span id="rdDay"></span><b id="rdDate"></b><span id="rdYear"></span></div><canvas id="cv"></canvas></div>
      <div class="hint">SCRATCH TO REVEAL!</div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="couple">
    <h2 class="script rv">Meet the Couple</h2>
    <p class="sub rv">Two hearts, one beautiful beginning.</p>
    <div class="pair" id="pair"></div>
  </section>

  <section class="together">
    <h2 class="script rv">Together, Forever</h2>
    <p class="sub rv">Two souls, one beautiful journey.</p>
    <div class="tframe rv"><div class="tim" id="tim"></div></div>
    <div class="tcap rv"><div class="tn" id="tnm"></div><div class="td" id="tdt"></div></div>
  </section>

  <section>
    <h2 class="script rv">The Big Day Approaches</h2>
    <div class="count rv" id="count"><div><b>00</b><span>DAYS</span></div><div><b>00</b><span>HOURS</span></div><div><b>00</b><span>MINUTES</span></div><div><b>00</b><span>SECONDS</span></div></div>
    <div class="stage rv" id="stage"></div>
  </section>

  <section class="story">
    <h2 class="script rv">Our Story</h2>
    <div class="rv" id="story"></div>
  </section>

  <section class="gsec">
    <h2 class="script rv" id="gtitle"></h2>
    <p class="sub rv">Moments we will treasure forever.</p>
    <div class="sw rv" id="sw"></div>
    <div id="gal"></div>
  </section>

  <section id="events"></section>

  <section class="bless rv">
    <h2 class="script">With Blessings From</h2>
    <div class="card" id="bless" ></div>
  </section>

  

  <section class="thanks">
    <div class="ring"><svg viewBox="0 0 136 136"><circle class="b" cx="68" cy="68" r="64"/><circle class="a" cx="68" cy="68" r="56"/></svg><span id="seal2"></span></div>
    <h2 class="rv">Thank You</h2>
    <p class="msg rv" id="tmsg"></p>
    <div class="nm2 rv" id="tnames"></div>
    <div class="dv"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 21s-8-5.3-8-11a4.5 4.5 0 0 1 8-2.8A4.5 4.5 0 0 1 20 10c0 5.700-8 11-8 11z"/></svg></div>
    <div class="lbl">FOR ANY QUESTIONS</div>
    <div class="rv" id="contacts"></div>
    <div class="tag" id="tag"></div>
    <p class="see">See you at the celebration.</p>
  </section>
</main>

<div class="fsw" id="fsw" hidden><button type="button" id="fbtn" aria-label="Change font style">Aa</button><div class="pn" id="fpn"></div></div>
<button class="disc" id="disc" aria-label="Play or pause music"></button>
<div class="lb" id="lb" hidden><button class="x" id="lbx" aria-label="Close">&times;</button><button class="pv" id="lbp" aria-label="Previous">&#8249;</button><img id="lbi" alt=""><button class="nx" id="lbn" aria-label="Next">&#8250;</button></div>
<audio id="audio" loop preload="auto"></audio>

<script>
/* ===================== EDIT EVERYTHING HERE ===================== */
const C = {
  groom:"Harsh", bride:"Simran",
  groomParents:"Son of Mrs. Jagmeet Kaur Hora & Mr. Kulbeer Singh Hora", brideParents:"Daughter of Mrs. Harneet Kaur Saluja & Mr. Chanveer Singh Saluja",
  weddingDate:"2026-11-16T11:00:00",          // used for countdown + scratch reveal
  imageCount:27, img:n=>`images/${n}.jpg`,    // photos: images/1.jpg … images/27.jpg
  audio:"music.mp3",
  groomImg:"images/groom.jpeg", brideImg:"images/bride.jpeg",   // portrait photos (ideally 3:4)
  togetherImg:"images/together.jpg",                 // photo of the bride and groom together (portrait, 4:5)
  groomBio:"Harsh Home Decor se kuch to lelo.",
  thanksMsg:"Your love and blessings mean the world to us. We cannot wait to celebrate with you.",
  hashtag:"",                                       // leave empty for #ArjunWedsMeera
  preTitle:"Pre-Wedding Moments",
  preCount:8, prePath:n=>`images/pre${n}.jpeg`,     // images/pre1.jpg … pre8.jpg (add as many as you like, raise preCount)
  preCaptions:[],                                   // optional, e.g. ["Where it began","Mountains","Sunsets"] (shown in Polaroid style)
  galleryStyle:"polaroid",                          // "polaroid" | "masonry" | "filmstrip"
  fontStyle:"romantic",                             // "romantic" | "royal" | "classic" | "modern"
  showFontSwitcher:true,                            // shows a small "Aa" button to preview; set false when decided
  showStyleSwitcher:true,                           // set false once you have picked a style
  brideBio:"Mujhe kota bula lo .",
  whatsapp:"918118854439",                     // country code + number, no "+"
  story:["Our story did not begin with years of knowing each other. It began with two people finding each other at exactly the right time.",
         "From the very beginning, we found comfort in quiet moments, joy in the unexpected ones, and a shared love for travel, family and each other."],
  events:[
  {name:"Haldi Ceremony",          date:"15 November 2026", time:"Sunday · 11 AM onwards",  img:"images/event2.jpg", venue:"Mukundra Sarovar Premiere Hotel", addr:"Near RTO office, Kota", map:"https://maps.app.goo.gl/CB3K8xaRe55J2eFbA"},
    {name:"Sangeet & Cocktail Party", date:"15 November 2026", time:"Sunday · 8 PM onwards", img:"images/event1.jpg", venue:"Mukundra Sarovar Premiere Hotel", addr:"Near RTO office, Kota", map:"https://maps.app.goo.gl/CB3K8xaRe55J2eFbA"},
    
    {name:"Laavan",   date:"16 November 2026", time:"Monday · 11 AM onwards",  img:"images/event3.jpg", venue:"Gurudwara Sahib", addr:"Near RTO office, Kota" },
    {name:"Reception",  date:"16 November 2026", time:"Monday · 2 PM onwards",   img:"images/event4.jpg", venue:"Mukundra Sarovar Premiere Hotel", addr:"Near RTO office, Kota", map:"https://maps.app.goo.gl/CB3K8xaRe55J2eFbA"}
  ],
  blessings:[["Hora Family","&"], ["Saluja Family","."]],
  contacts:[["Contact Name","+91 90000 00000"],["Contact Name","+1 000 000 0000"]]
};
/* ================================================================ */
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id), D=new Date(C.weddingDate);

/* fill content */
$("seal").textContent=C.groom[0]+C.bride[0];
["gn","gn2"].forEach(i=>$(i).textContent=C.groom);["bn","bn2"].forEach(i=>$(i).textContent=C.bride);
$("gp").textContent=C.groomParents;$("bp").textContent=C.brideParents;
$("rdDay").textContent=D.toLocaleDateString("en-GB",{weekday:"long"}).toUpperCase();
$("rdDate").textContent=D.toLocaleDateString("en-GB",{day:"numeric",month:"long"});
$("rdYear").textContent=D.getFullYear();
$("story").innerHTML=C.story.map(t=>`<p>${t}</p>`).join("");
$("events").innerHTML=C.events.map(e=>`<div class="ev rv"><div class="script">${e.name}</div><div class="when">${e.date.toUpperCase()}</div><div class="at">${e.time.toUpperCase()}</div>
  <img src="${e.img}" alt="" loading="lazy" onerror="this.remove()"><div class="at">VENUE</div><div class="v">${e.venue.toUpperCase()}</div><div class="a">${e.addr.toUpperCase()}</div>
  <a class="btn" href="${e.map}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">VIEW ON MAPS</a></div>`).join("");
$("bless").innerHTML=C.blessings.map(b=>`<div><b>${b[0].toUpperCase()}</b>${b[1]}</div>`).join("");
const ph='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6.600 10.800a15.200 15.200 0 0 0 6.600 6.600l2.200-2.200c.3-.3.700-.4 1-.2 1.100.4 2.300.6 3.600.6.600 0 1 .4 1 1V20c0 .6-.4 1-1 1A17 17 0 0 1 3 4c0-.6.4-1 1-1h3.500c.6 0 1 .4 1 1 0 1.300.2 2.500.6 3.600.1.300 0 .700-.2 1l-2.300 2.200z"/></svg>';
$("contacts").innerHTML=C.contacts.map(c=>`<a class="cn" href="tel:${c[1].replace(/[^+\d]/g,"")}"><div><b>${c[0].toUpperCase()}</b><span>${c[1]}</span></div><i>${ph}</i></a>`).join("");
$("seal2").textContent=C.groom[0]+C.bride[0];$("tnames").textContent=C.groom+" & "+C.bride;
$("tmsg").textContent=C.thanksMsg;$("tag").textContent=C.hashtag||("#"+C.groom+"Weds"+C.bride);

/* font styles */
const FONTS={
  romantic:{n:"Romantic",s:"'Great Vibes','Snell Roundhand',cursive",b:"'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif",c:"'Cinzel',Georgia,serif",si:"normal",bi:"italic",k:1.3,bs:1.12},
  royal:{n:"Royal",s:"'Cinzel Decorative','Cinzel',Georgia,serif",b:"'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif",c:"'Cinzel',Georgia,serif",si:"normal",bi:"italic",k:.78,bs:1.12},
  classic:{n:"Classic",s:"'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif",b:"'Lora',Georgia,serif",c:"'Cinzel',Georgia,serif",si:"italic",bi:"italic",k:1,bs:1},
  modern:{n:"Modern",s:"'Poppins',system-ui,sans-serif",b:"'Poppins',system-ui,sans-serif",c:"'Poppins',system-ui,sans-serif",si:"normal",bi:"normal",k:.82,bs:1}};
function setFont(k){const f=FONTS[k]||FONTS.romantic,r=document.documentElement.style;
  r.setProperty("--script",f.s);r.setProperty("--serif",f.b);r.setProperty("--caps",f.c);r.setProperty("--si",f.si);r.setProperty("--bi",f.bi);r.setProperty("--ss",f.k);r.setProperty("--bs",f.bs);
  [...$("fpn").children].forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle("on",x.dataset.k==k))}
$("fpn").innerHTML=Object.entries(FONTS).map(([k,f])=>`<button type="button" data-k="${k}" style="font-family:${f.s};font-style:${f.si}">${f.n}</button>`).join("");
$("fpn").onclick=e=>{if(e.target.dataset.k){setFont(e.target.dataset.k);$("fsw").classList.remove("open")}};
$("fbtn").onclick=()=>$("fsw").classList.toggle("open");
$("fsw").hidden=!C.showFontSwitcher;
setFont(C.fontStyle);

/* gate → open → start */
const audio=$("audio"),disc=$("disc");audio.src=C.audio;
function playing(p){disc.classList.toggle("play",p)}
disc.onclick=()=>audio.paused?audio.play().then(()=>playing(true)).catch(()=>{}):(audio.pause(),playing(false));
$("gate").onclick=()=>{const g=$("gate");g.classList.add("open");document.body.classList.add("opening");audio.play().then(()=>playing(true)).catch(()=>playing(false));
  setTimeout(()=>{g.classList.add("gone");document.body.classList.remove("lock");document.body.classList.add("started");$("heroNames").classList.add("in");startSlides()},2300)};

/* bride & groom */
$("pair").innerHTML=[["groom","THE GROOM"],["bride","THE BRIDE"]].map(([k,r])=>`<div class="p rv"><div class="frame"><div class="im" id="im-${k}"></div></div><div class="role">${r}</div><h3>${C[k]}</h3><small>${C[k+"Parents"]}</small><p>${C[k+"Bio"]}</p></div>`).join("")+'<div class="heart"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 21s-8-5.3-8-11a4.5 4.5 0 0 1 8-2.8A4.5 4.5 0 0 1 20 10c0 5.700-8 11-8 11z"/></svg></div>';
["groom","bride"].forEach(k=>{const el=$("im-"+k),i=new Image();i.alt=C[k];i.src=C[k+"Img"];i.onload=()=>{el.innerHTML="";el.appendChild(i)};el.innerHTML=`<span class="pl">${C[k][0]}</span><span class="pt">ADD PHOTO</span>`});

/* together photo */
$("tnm").textContent=C.groom+" & "+C.bride;
$("tdt").textContent=D.toLocaleDateString("en-GB",{day:"numeric",month:"long",year:"numeric"}).toUpperCase();
(()=>{const el=$("tim"),i=new Image();i.alt=C.groom+" and "+C.bride;i.src=C.togetherImg;
  el.innerHTML=`<span class="pl">${C.groom[0]} & ${C.bride[0]}</span><span class="pt">ADD PHOTO</span>`;
  i.onload=()=>{el.innerHTML="";el.appendChild(i)}})();

/* petals + hero date */
for(let i=0;i<16;i++){const p=document.createElement("i");p.className="petal";p.style.left=Math.random()*100+"%";p.style.animationDuration=(6+Math.random()*6)+"s";p.style.animationDelay=(-Math.random()*8)+"s";p.style.background=["#f6c4cf","#fff","#f9dca8"][i%3];$("gate").appendChild(p)}
$("gname").textContent=C.groom+" & "+C.bride;$("gdate").textContent=D.toLocaleDateString("en-GB",{day:"numeric",month:"long",year:"numeric"}).toUpperCase();
$("hd").textContent=D.toLocaleDateString("en-GB",{day:"numeric",month:"long",year:"numeric"}).toUpperCase();

/* scroll reveals */
const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(x=>{if(x.isIntersecting){x.target.classList.add("in");io.unobserve(x.target)}}),{threshold:.15});
document.querySelectorAll(".rv").forEach(el=>el!==$("heroNames")&&io.observe(el));

/* pre-wedding gallery */
(()=>{const gal=$("gal"),sec=gal.parentElement,pics=[];$("gtitle").textContent=C.preTitle;
  const styles=[["polaroid","Polaroid"],["masonry","Collage"],["filmstrip","Filmstrip"]];
  function setStyle(k){gal.className="g-"+k;[...$("sw").children].forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("on",b.dataset.k==k))}
  $("sw").innerHTML=C.showStyleSwitcher?styles.map(x=>`<button type="button" data-k="${x[0]}">${x[1]}</button>`).join(""):"";
  $("sw").onclick=e=>{if(e.target.dataset.k)setStyle(e.target.dataset.k)};
  const lb=$("lb"),li=$("lbi");let at=0,x0=0;
  const show=i=>{at=(i+pics.length)%pics.length;li.src=pics[at];lb.hidden=false};
  $("lbx").onclick=()=>lb.hidden=true;$("lbp").onclick=()=>show(at-1);$("lbn").onclick=()=>show(at+1);
  lb.onclick=e=>{if(e.target===lb)lb.hidden=true};
  lb.addEventListener("touchstart",e=>x0=e.touches[0].clientX,{passive:true});
  lb.addEventListener("touchend",e=>{const d=e.changedTouches[0].clientX-x0;if(Math.abs(d)>50)show(at+(d<0?1:-1))});
  addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(lb.hidden)return;if(e.key=="Escape")lb.hidden=true;if(e.key=="ArrowLeft")show(at-1);if(e.key=="ArrowRight")show(at+1)});
  Promise.all(Array.from({length:C.preCount},(_,i)=>new Promise(r=>{const im=new Image();im.onload=()=>r(im);im.onerror=()=>r(null);im.src=C.prePath(i+1)}))).then(list=>{
    const ok=list.map((im,i)=>im&&[im,C.preCaptions[i]||""]).filter(Boolean);
    if(!ok.length){sec.style.display="none";return}
    ok.forEach(([im,cap],i)=>{pics.push(im.src);const d=document.createElement("div");d.className="it rv";d.style.setProperty("--r",[-3,2.5,-1.5,3,-2.5,1.5][i%6]+"deg");d.style.transitionDelay=(i%2)*.15+"s";
      d.dataset.cap=cap;im.alt="Pre-wedding photo "+(i+1);im.loading="lazy";d.appendChild(im);d.onclick=()=>show(i);gal.appendChild(d);io.observe(d)});
    setStyle(C.galleryStyle)})
})();
/* countdown */
function tick(){let s=Math.max(0,Math.floor((D-new Date())/1000));const v=[Math.floor(s/86400),Math.floor(s%86400/3600),Math.floor(s%3600/60),s%60];
  document.querySelectorAll("#count b").forEach((b,i)=>b.textContent=String(v[i]).padStart(2,"0"))}
tick();setInterval(tick,1000);

/* photo carousel: 1.5s crossfade/glide, new photo every 3.5s */
const urls=Array.from({length:C.imageCount},(_,i)=>C.img(i+1)),stage=$("stage");let cards=[],idx=0,timer;
function startSlides(){
  Promise.all(urls.map(u=>new Promise(r=>{const i=new Image();i.onload=()=>r(u);i.onerror=()=>r(null);i.src=u}))).then(ok=>{
    const good=ok.filter(Boolean);if(!good.length){stage.style.display="none";return}
    cards=good.map(u=>{const d=document.createElement("div");d.className="ph";d.style.backgroundImage=`url("${u}")`;stage.appendChild(d);return d});
    paint();if(good.length>1)timer=setInterval(()=>{idx=(idx+1)%cards.length;paint()},3500)})}
function paint(){const n=cards.length;cards.forEach((c,i)=>{c.className="ph"+(i==idx?" c":i==(idx-1+n)%n?" p":i==(idx+1)%n?" n":"")})}
document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",()=>{if(document.hidden)clearInterval(timer);else if(cards.length>1){clearInterval(timer);timer=setInterval(()=>{idx=(idx+1)%cards.length;paint()},3500)}});

/* scratch-to-reveal heart */
const cv=$("cv"),ctx=cv.getContext("2d");let done=false,down=false;
function size(){const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect(),d=devicePixelRatio||1;cv.width=r.width*d;cv.height=r.height*d;
  const w=cv.width,h=cv.height,g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,w,h);g.addColorStop(0,"#f6d57a");g.addColorStop(.5,"#c9962f");g.addColorStop(1,"#f0c96a");
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation="source-over";ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(w*.5,h*.97);ctx.bezierCurveTo(-w*.15,h*.5,w*.13,-h*.04,w*.5,h*.25);ctx.bezierCurveTo(w*.87,-h*.04,w*1.15,h*.5,w*.5,h*.97);ctx.fill()}
size();
function scratch(e){if(!down||done)return;const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect(),k=cv.width/r.width;
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation="destination-out";ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc((e.clientX-r.left)*k,(e.clientY-r.top)*k,26*k,0,7);ctx.fill()}
function check(){const w=cv.width,h=cv.height,s=ctx.getImageData(0,0,w,h).data;let t=0,c=0;
  for(let y=0;y<h;y+=8)for(let x=0;x<w;x+=8){t++;if(s[(y*w+x)*4+3]<40)c++}
  if(c/t>.34){done=true;cv.style.opacity=0;setTimeout(()=>cv.remove(),1000)}}
cv.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{down=true;cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);scratch(e)});
cv.addEventListener("pointermove",scratch);
["pointerup","pointercancel"].forEach(t=>cv.addEventListener(t,()=>{down=false;check()}));
</script>
</body>
</html>
